messages:
Nadia: Heads-up : ran a focused onboard for 'horizon-lite-9b' int6 vs int8. Short note on cost/quality + routing heuristics.

Omar: Nice, what slices and sample sizes?

Nadia: Slices: chat (60%), retrieval (30%), extractive-summaries (10%). 400 samples each.

Priya: Top-line econ?

Nadia: Infra unit cost per 1k tokens: int8 ~$0.011, int6 ~$0.0065 (~40% lower). Latency p95: int8=115ms, int6=205ms. Throughput down ~14% on int6.

Omar: Quality deltas? Any surprising failure modes?

Nadia: Weighted quality score drops ~0.9% absolute. Broken down: chat QA -0.03 (5pt), retrieval MRR -0.8% absolute, summaries ROUGE-L -0.6. Hallucination proxy +0.45% concentrated on multi-step numeric and dense date contexts.

Priya: CI sound? 400 samples ok?

Nadia: Moderate. Bootstrap CI MRR +/-0.45%. Recommend a 1k-sample shadow for retrieval; 48h 5% chat canary after that.

Omar: Routing heuristics proposal?

Nadia: Prototype rules: 1) Force-int8 for request.metadata.features contains any of ["retrieval","billing","numeric-exact"]. 2) Allow-int6 for chat when estimated_tokens < 1200 and metadata.latency_sensitive != true. 3) Fallback to int8 on hallucination-detection post-filter. 4) Cache: extend prefix TTL for summarization-heavy routes.

Priya: Quick GTN blurb please.

Nadia: Draft: "Int6 yields ~35-45% infra savings with small, concentrated quality regressions (numeric/retrieval). Recommend targeted hybrid routing: retain int8 for high-precision endpoints, use int6 for bulk chat after a 1k shadow and 48h guarded canary. Include prompt-level guards for numeric/date patterns."

CI-Bot: Test coverage: none required for routing heuristics; please open a roll-out checklist ticket linking canary gates and alert rules.

Omar: Action items: Nadia run 1k shadow for retrieval, attach failure examples; Priya prepare 1-pager for GTN; CI-Bot create checklist ticket.

Nadia: On it, will upload the 1k job output and top 20 failure prompts by EOD. :rocket:
